mode_note: Đổi thành "frozen" khi chốt giao thức trước lượt chính; runner từ chối chạy chính khi chưa frozen. Không sửa file này giữa chừng một lượt.
selection: validation macro_f1; tie keeps the earlier epoch

gate.rule: Practical pilot gate fixed before launch; not a significance test. Independent of multichunk_pilot.json gate.

replace_A_reference.note: Head-tail seed42 validation F1 + 0.005 and its long-review F1; informational for replacing model A.

operations.note: Run B2 then C1 sequentially; avoid games/3D apps during long runs; on CUDA error resume from latest.pt in a new process.

test_policy: No test access during development, pilot or seed extension. Test only via evaluate_chunk_compare.py after method/checkpoint selection is locked on validation.
